text: こくばんに　かかれてる　こと　ちゃんと　みて！

structure.jp: こくばんに　かかれてる　こと
structure.en: what is written on the blackboard

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: The て-form alone is a casual request or command. みて！ = 'Look!'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short form of ている and says the state is ongoing; かかれて is 'is written'. かかれてる こと = 'what is written'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こくばんに　かかれてる　こと
patterns.explanation: The words before こと tell which thing. こくばんに　かかれてる　こと = 'what is written on the blackboard'.
